props.title: An acoustic duo or trio for hire in Denver for cocktail hours and dinner parties.
props.lede: Everyone has a song like Wild World, the one you catch yourself humming along to with a drink in your hand. Our acoustic duo is either voice and guitar or guitar and upright bass. For a bigger crowd, a third musician makes it a trio.

headingText.html: It’s a great choice when you want live music that feels relaxed and personal.

props.title: What does an acoustic duo play?
props.lede: We mostly play singer-songwriter and folk-rock covers people know the words to, like Free Fallin’, Margaritaville and Ain’t No Sunshine. Prefer jazz standards? Check out our jazz duo.

props.html: If there’s a song you want that isn’t on the list, just let us know when you book and the duo can usually learn it.

props.title: Which acoustic duo or trio is right for you?

rows.text: A singer and a guitarist are a great fit for cocktail hours, welcome drinks and patios, and they can keep familiar songs just loud enough to feel like live music without taking over the conversation.
This is our instrumental duo, and it’s a lovely choice for dinner. The melodies are still familiar, and without lyrics the music can sit under the conversation at the table.

rows.term: The trio: voice, guitar and upright bass
rows.text: With a trio, you get a fuller sound for a bigger crowd, and the musicians can play one set with vocals and one without.

props.html: Need just one musician? Our singer and guitarist is one person who sings and plays guitar. Want your event to end on the dance floor? Tejas Singh can start as a duo and grow to a quartet.

rows.text: We can play the hour between the ceremony and dinner, with or without vocals, at a Denver venue or up in the mountains.
The duo can play at your home, at a club or in a private dining space, in Denver or Colorado Springs.
An acoustic duo is a nice way to welcome guests to a company event before the program starts.
When the conversation is what matters most, the instrumental duo can play quietly through the whole dinner.

items.a: It’s about as loud as the conversation around it. You’ll hear that it’s live music from across the venue, and the people at the nearest table can still talk easily. The musicians set their volume to fit your space, and they’re happy to adjust it.

items.q: How long can the duo play?
items.a: The duo usually plays 45 to 60 minutes at a time with 15 to 20 minutes between sets, and we can keep music playing through the breaks. A single hour works well, and so does playing from the time guests arrive through dessert. If you think the night might run long, let us know when you book.

items.q: Can the acoustic duo play outside?
items.a: Yes, and it’s a great fit for a patio. We’ll just need a dry, level spot under cover with power nearby, and we’ll size the sound system to your space. Colorado evenings cool down fast, so we’ll work out a plan with you for moving indoors.

props.lede: We’d love to help with your event, and one person will look after you from the first email through the last song.
